title: Trademark, Spacing & Sizing
slide_intent: Give a mark room and sufficient size so people can distinguish its parts at the intended viewing scale.
strategic_value: Shared spacing and size limits can keep T-Mobile marks legible across production formats.
demonstration: Three mark variants are shown with notice symbols, clear-space boxes and print/digital minimum sizes.
practical_value: Measure logo margins with the digit unit and check the minimum for the chosen mark and medium.

content_islands.name: Notice and disclaimer rules
content_islands.spec: Place the media-specific explanation and disclaimer at left.

content_islands.name: Notice examples
content_islands.spec: Align full logo, T-Digit and badge across the top.

content_islands.name: Clear-space diagrams
content_islands.spec: Repeat the three marks in measured boxes in the middle.

content_islands.name: Minimum sizes
content_islands.spec: Show small specimens and their print/digital labels along the bottom.

ingredient.name: Logo clear space and minimum size
ingredient.role: Keep the brand mark distinct from surrounding content.
ingredient.application: Reserve at least two square digits around the lockup and T-Digit. Minimum full-logo width is 1 inch print or 72 px digital; T-Digit is .25 inch or 18 px; badge is .30 inch or 24 px.
ingredient.scope: The three illustrated brand marks and their stated print/digital uses.
